en.headline: Hong Kong studying more no-booking days for northbound cars
en.dek: Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan said the city is talking with Guangdong about extending the Tuesday-Wednesday waiver to other quieter weekdays.
body: The Hong Kong and Guangdong governments are studying whether more non-peak weekdays can be added to the list of days when Hong Kong private cars may cross the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge without a booking, Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan told the Legislative Council on Wednesday.

Chan said about 160,000 Hong Kong private cars have taken part in Northbound Travel since the scheme began in 2023, or roughly one in four eligible vehicles. Booking is already waived on Tuesdays and Wednesdays, except public holidays and their eves. She said the two governments would keep watching traffic and look at widening that waiver to other quieter working days.

She also said Guangdong cars travelling south under the counterpart scheme have been able to come from all nine Greater Bay Area mainland cities since mid-year. The target is to open the scheme to all 21 cities in Guangdong by the first quarter of 2027, with a possible increase in the daily quota.

Chan expected heavy northbound traffic during the mainland National Day Golden Week. She separately updated lawmakers on three planned smart green mass-transit projects: the Kai Tak contract is due this year with a 2031 opening target, East Kowloon is aimed at a 2027 award and opening by 2033, and Hung Shui Kiu/Ha Tsuen is expected to tender by year-end.

zh.headline: 港粵研究更多工作日港車北上免預約
zh.dek: 運輸及物流局局長陳美寶向立法會表示，正與廣東商討把週二、三免預約安排擴至其他非繁忙工作天。
body: 運輸及物流局局長陳美寶星期三在立法會交通事務委員會表示，港粵政府正研究把「港車北上」免預約安排，由現時的星期二及星期三，進一步擴展至其他非繁忙工作天。
陳美寶說，措施自2023年實施以來約有16萬輛香港私家車參與，相當於每四輛合資格車輛便有一輛參加。去年9月起已取消逢星期二和星期三的預約要求，公眾假期及前夕除外。雙方會繼續留意實施情況並優化安排。
至於「粵車南下」，她指今年年中已擴展至大灣區全部九個內地城市，目標是2027年第一季或之前覆蓋廣東省全部21個城市，並會研究增加每日配額。
她預計內地十一黃金周期間會有大量港車經港珠澳大橋北上。她亦向議員交代智慧綠色集體運輸項目進度：啟德項目預計今年內批出合約、2031年通車；東九龍目標明年批出合約、2033年或之前通車；洪水橋及厦村項目預期今年年底招標。
